units.name: formation.isr_36_div_tank_group
units.source: Assumption: the tank part of the 36th Division (the Peled ugda) that climbed to the southern Golan on 10 June; its brigades 37 and 45 are already on the map, so this unit stands for the rest of the division force. Jewish Virtual Library, 'Day-by-Day Action Review of the Six-Day War' (from IDF material): 'The Peled division engaged in combat in the southern Golan' https://jewishvirtuallibrary.org/day-by-day-action-review-of-the-six-day-war; Wikipedia '36th Division (Israel)' (division number) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/36th_Division_(Israel)

units.name: formation.isr_10_harel_mech
units.source: 10th 'Harel' Brigade, moved from Jerusalem: ordered to the Golan the night before the ceasefire, entered via Gonen and Darbashiya to Rafid junction and Khushniya. Council for the Preservation of Heritage Sites, 'Harel Armored Brigade' https://shimur.org/signs/חטיבת-שריון-הראל/; Jewish Virtual Library, 'Day-by-Day Action Review of the Six-Day War': 'The 10th brigade ascended ... in the late afternoon and had already advanced into Chushia that night' https://jewishvirtuallibrary.org/day-by-day-action-review-of-the-six-day-war; composition (2 tank battalions + half-track infantry battalion): balagan.info, 'Israeli Order of Battle in the 1967 Arab-Israeli War' https://balagan.info/israeli-order-of-battle-in-the-1967-arab-israeli-war

events._comment: Приказ об отходе (R-EVT-01): Израиль взял Масаду (северный прорыв) или NM Сирии опустилась ниже стартовых 70%. Исторически Кунейтра пала после приказа, почти без боя. Срабатывает в фазу Израиля, чтобы −2 окопа действовали при его атаках.
